review.posthog_relevance: Dashboard state management and potential race condition prevention during grid compaction save operations.
review.reason: Adds frontend state and setters to disable grid compaction while a save is in flight, potentially preventing inconsistent states or race conditions. This is a localized, bounded behavior correction.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on frontend implementation; backend API support and complete implementation are not visible, preventing assessment of systemic correctness or broader impact.
